keyword: diesel pump on a grid building site

title.en: The buyer’s check on this page is can a diesel row be copied onto a grid-powered site
title.zh: 本页要核对的是：柴油行能抄到有电网的工地上吗

description.en: Taken from the printed row: No. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the split on the selection guide: no stable grid means a diesel trailer or the rural diesel pump; stable power means Electric 20–80 / HBT. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. A building with a real motor supply uses the electric distance and aggregate rows. Read it in the Xingtai table. Copying Diesel 50’s 150 m / 450 m onto Electric 50, or Diesel 120’s 100 m³/h onto Electric 80, mixes tables.
description.zh: 不能。河北品锦机械（邢台）在选型指南里把界限写明：没有稳定电网用柴油拖泵或农村柴油泵；供电稳定用电动20–80 / HBT。真正有电机电源的建筑，用电动的距离和骨料行。把柴油50的 150 m / 450 m 抄到电动50上，或把柴油120的 100 m³/h 抄到电动80上，都是在混表。
